note: Hand-computed artificial example (protocol 6, RECOUNT_SPEC.md 11). Not from the 48 pages. OCR boxes are [x, y, w, h] in original page pixels and are read with their original JSON number text for W3 (RECOUNT_SPEC 4.0). Bands are {left, top, width, height}; ink rects and cells are half-open [l, t, r, b). In the w3 cases r is the fixed W2 output (reason, w1, w2, w2Reason) given by hand; DEF means W1 = {0,0,400,200}, W2 = {0,0,400,60} cut, hit word 0 = '가나다' [10,20,40,20] (x1 50, y 20..40, height 20).

squash.why: U+FEFF is not White_Space and stays
NFKC maps full-width digits and colon to ASCII

qtypes.why: 몇시간 contains 몇시 (substring rule, a registered limit)
two cues of the same type merge into one

w3.name: split_number_and_unit_gap_exactly_half
w3.why: gap 130 - 120 = 10, 2*10 = 20 <= min(20,20): joined to 12명. '12' and '명' alone do not match the count grammar.

w3.name: split_gap_over_half_rejected
w3.why: gap 10.5, 2*10.5 = 21 > 20: not joined. No unit matches.

w3.name: reversed_order_not_sorted
w3.why: In OCR order '명' then '12': x0(12) - x1(명) = 100 - 150 < 0. The words are not re-sorted; '명12' would not match anyway.

w3.name: negative_gap_rejected
w3.why: gap 119 - 120 = -1 < 0 (overlapping words): not joined.

w3.name: blank_word_breaks_the_run
w3.why: Word 2 squashes to '' and breaks every unit that contains it. It is not skipped, so '12' and '명' never join.

w3.name: zero_width_word_breaks_the_run
w3.why: Word 2 has width 0 (invalid) and breaks the run. If it were deleted, '9' and '명' (gap 0) would join to 9명.

w3.name: null_coordinate_breaks_the_run
w3.why: A null (non-finite) coordinate makes word 2 invalid.

w3.name: shared_hit_word_counterexample
w3.why: h1 = [0,0,10,10], h2 = [0,15,10,25], j1 '12' = [10,2,15,9], j2 '명' = [15,16,19,23], gap 0. h1 supports j1 (x0 10 >= 10, overlap 7, 14 >= 7) but not j2 (overlap 0). h2 supports j2 (overlap 7) but not j1 (overlap 0). No single h supports both words: 12명 is rejected. A union-box hit [0,0,10,25] would have accepted it.

w3.name: two_hits_same_height_support_once
w3.why: Both hits (x1 10 and 22, y 0..10) support '12명' (x0 30, overlap 8, 16 >= 8). The unit key (0, 2, 2) is counted once.

w3.name: touching_left_edge_allowed
w3.why: x0 50 = hit x1 50: touching edges are allowed.

w3.name: one_px_left_overlap_rejected
w3.why: x0 49 < hit x1 50: one pixel of horizontal overlap is not 'right of the hit'.

w3.name: exactly_half_vertical_overlap_allowed
w3.why: hit y 0..1, word y 0.5..1.5: overlap 0.5, 2*0.5 = 1 >= min(1,1) = 1 (exactly half is allowed).

w3.name: exact_decimal_sum_boundary
w3.why: Exact: hit x1 = 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3 and x0 0.3 >= 0.3 (touching). Binary floating point gives 0.30000000000000004 > 0.3 and would wrongly reject.

w3.name: same_text_two_positions
w3.why: Same text at two positions = two units (keys differ).

w3.name: overlapping_valid_units
w3.why: '1'+'2:30' (gap 0) = 12:30 and '2:30' alone both match; overlapping valid units are both counted.

w3.name: candidate_outside_w2_by_one_px
w3.why: Same row (x0 90 >= 50, overlap 10, 20 >= 10). C = [90,20,101,30]; W2 right edge 100 < 101: not completely inside, W1 kept.

w3.name: not_applicable_no_cut_keeps_diagnostic_scan
w3.why: W2 did not narrow W1 (no_cut): W3 = W1. The diagnostic scan is still recorded but not used.

w3.name: not_applicable_not_wider
w3.why: inherit: not applicable.

w3.name: technical_error
w3.why: Technical error: no window, not a hold.

w3.name: normal_unmatched
w3.why: Normal unmatched: no window.

w3.name: qtype_none
w3.why: No type cue: W1 kept, no scan (needs exactly one type).

w3.name: qtype_multiple
w3.why: Two types: W1 kept.

w3.name: hours_substring_counts_as_time
w3.why: 몇시간 contains 몇시: classified as time (registered limit of the substring rule).

w3.name: invalid_hit_excluded_one_left
w3.why: Hit 0 has width 0 and leaves H; hit 1 (x1 90) supports '10:30' (x0 100).

w3.name: all_hits_invalid
w3.why: The only hit has height 0: H is empty, a normal hold (W1).

w3.name: full_width_digits_and_colon
w3.why: NFKC turns １０：３０ into 10:30.

w3.name: candidate_on_another_ocr_line_same_position
w3.why: The OCR line number may differ from the hit line when the position is the same row.

w3.name: value_one_row_below_is_not_a_candidate
w3.why: Word y 60..78 vs hit 20..40: overlap 0.

w3.name: four_tokens_are_not_joined
w3.why: At most 3 tokens: '1'+'0'+':'+'30' is never formed; '0'+':'+'30' = 0:30 matches (hour 0) and is the unique unit. The rule does not judge meaning.

pipeline.name: fixed_w1_w2_then_w3_no_candidate
pipeline.why: Same W1/W2. Count question: '10:30' is not a count unit, 0 candidates, W3 = W1.

classify.name: target_value
classify.why: centre (220,110) in r1-value cell; C meets its ink

classify.name: aux_item_is_other
classify.why: confirmed item r1-auxA is none of the three named classes

classify.name: two_words_two_cells
classify.why: centres (287.5,110) in r1-value, (310,110) in r1-decoy: two items

classify.name: centre_on_half_open_right_edge
classify.why: centre x 295 in r1-value cell [190,300): assigned; but C [290,300] vs ink [200,240]: x overlap 240-290 < 0, zero intersection -> ambiguous

classify.name: centre_outside_every_cell
classify.why: centre x 300 is outside r1-value [190,300) (half-open) and before r1-decoy 305: unassigned

pages.why: W1 [60,260) holds label, value and both other values; W2 = W3 = [80,140) keeps label and value, other values (181.., 221..) fall out: common opportunity, events W2 and W3.
The unique same-row candidate is the decoy; W3 applies W2 [80,140) and the answer below (141..159) falls out: the registered risk case, a W3 loss.
No same-row candidate: W3 keeps W1 and the W2 loss is prevented.
Two candidates: W3 holds W1, so the W2 removal event is not kept by W3.
W2 no_cut: not applicable and outside the common opportunity set; the diagnostic unique candidate is still classified.
Technical error: stays in the 48-page denominator, fails every window.
W1 is the whole page (area 120000 = page area): not strict by the fixed definition. W2/W3 are partial and hold both parts: the only possible strict recovery.

scoring.why: Totals by hand from the 8 rows. W1 strict = p1..p5 (p8 is whole-page). L2 = {p2, p3} of 5, L3 = {p2}; p3 is prevented (W3 held W1). Opportunity = p1..p4 (cut, W1 strict, other values full in W1); event2 = p1, p4; event3 = p1 (p4 held). Area A = 120000: W2 cuts 56000 x4, 0, 96000 -> sum 320000, mean 320000*100/(6*120000) = 44.4444, median (56000+56000)/2 -> 46.6667, max 80. W3 cuts 56000, 56000, 0, 0, 0, 96000 -> sum 208000, mean 28.8889, median (0+56000)/2 = 28000 -> 23.3333, max 80; applied p1, p2, p8 -> mean 208000*100/(3*120000) = 57.7778, median 56000 -> 46.6667.
